reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Remodeling Eye Patch 60P
reviews.text: Very juicy eye patches. So nice to use, stick well and very soothing wherever I place them. They are an odd texture which I like, quite fragile and very slippery when you are trying to get one out of the pot lol Wonderful stuff!
reviews.zh: 眼膜精華好充足（juicy）。用起嚟好舒服，貼得好穩，貼喺邊度都好舒緩。佢哋嘅質地有點特別，我好鍾意，就係有啲易爛，而且要喺罐入面攞出嚟嗰陣好滑 lol。好正嘅產品！

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Remodeling Eye Patch 60P
reviews.text: Great eye mask! Fine lines appear plumped and less noticeable after use. Keep in mind it won't reverse existing wrinkles, but it helps prevent them from getting worse. Very hydrating and perfect for priming under the eyes before makeup.
reviews.zh: 好正嘅眼膜！用完細紋睇落會飽滿啲、冇咁明顯。要留意，佢唔可以逆轉而家已經有嘅皺紋，但可以幫助預防皺紋惡化。保濕力好強，做化妝前嘅眼部打底都好啱。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Remodeling Eye Patch 60P
reviews.text: Hydrating and fun to use, the jelly texture is nice, I don’t expect much from eyepatches to be honest but it is nice to use in the mornings (the spatula that comes with it is sort of useless)
reviews.zh: 保濕，用起嚟有趣，果凍質地好好。老實講，我對眼膜冇咩期望，但係朝早用都幾好（附送嗰支小刮勺有啲冇用）。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Remodeling Eye Patch 60P
reviews.text: まだあんまり使ってないから、どんななのかあんまりわからないけど。いいんじゃない？
reviews.zh: 未點用過，所以唔太知道係點樣，但係都幾好吧？

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Remodeling Eye Patch 60P
reviews.text: Have bought many undereye patches but never motivated to use it after one or two uses. This one made the diff, it adhered well on my undereyes due to the ridges and I could feel my undereyes becoming firmer and less visible undereye vein and fine lines.
reviews.zh: 我買過好多眼下眼膜，但係通常用一兩次就冇咗動力繼續用。呢款就有唔同，因為有紋路，所以貼眼下貼得好穩，我感覺眼下變得更緊緻，眼下嘅青筋同細紋亦冇咁明顯。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Remodeling Eye Patch 60P
reviews.text: I’m not usually one to invest in eye patches as I’d rather use a face mask to do my entire face. However these eye patches are different; to start with, they don’t slide off your face! They have little ridges so they grip really well to your skin and stay in place. They also fully allow your skin to fully absorb the essence! They’re soft so they’re not irritating and feel much nicer than the silicone type ones (personal preference). Overall, such a lovely product! I will enjoy using these 2-3 times a week before bed.
reviews.zh: 我通常唔會投資眼膜，因為我寧願用面膜敷全臉。不過呢款眼膜唔同：首先，佢哋唔會喺面上滑落！佢哋有細細嘅紋路，所以好緊貼皮膚，又會留喺原位。佢哋亦都可以令皮膚完全吸收精華！佢哋好軟，所以唔會刺激，而且（個人喜好）比矽膠類嘅眼膜感覺好多。整體嚟講，係一款好靚嘅產品！我會每個禮拜瞓覺前用兩至三次，用得好開心。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Remodeling Eye Patch 60P
reviews.text: I like these masks as they stay on and don’t slip down so you can continue with your activity. They also turn clear once absorption is completed. I don’t see my wrinkles going away but eye area is soft and plump. It’s a good alternative to heavy retinols which irritate my eye area. Plus I’m not constantly having to push them back up so they will definitely be a repurchase.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢款眼膜，因為佢貼得穩，唔會滑低，你可以繼續做嘢。吸收完成之後，佢哋會變得透明。我未見到皺紋消失，但係眼周變得柔軟、飽滿。對於會刺激眼周嘅厚身視黃醇（retinol）嚟講，佢係一個好替代品。另外，我唔使成日推返上去，所以一定會回購。
